title_zh: 理清悬疑剧角色的追查动机再重排

scenario.goal_zh: 澄清虚构案件的角色关系并确定继续排练的位置。

context_zh: 两名业余演员核对虚构悬疑剧中警察和记者的关系，并准备从关键台词重新排练。
author: author-phase07-a

sentences.speaker: Zoe
sentences.text: Why does your character chase mine out of the café? I thought they were working together.

sentences.speaker: Cal
sentences.text: They were, but the cop now thinks the reporter is part of the conspiracy.

sentences.speaker: Zoe
sentences.text: Does he want to capture her, or just get the envelope back?

sentences.speaker: Cal
sentences.text: Only the envelope at this point. He hasn't realised she's trying to protect his witness.

sentences.speaker: Zoe
sentences.text: That changes how I play the scene. I should look hurt, not frightened of being arrested.

sentences.speaker: Cal
sentences.text: Exactly. Let's go back to your line about what was in the envelope.

sentences.speaker: Zoe
sentences.text: Ready. 'If you trusted me, you'd let me explain what was in that envelope.'
